fields.body: Mark the topic with は, the subject with が. The topic is what the sentence is about; が often introduces something new.
fields.title: は versus が

fields.body: Play the audio once with the text, once without, then say the line at the same speed. Three passes then stop - the scheduler decides when it returns.
fields.title: A shadowing routine that sticks

fields.body: Write each kana once and say it aloud; the card is not learned until the sound arrives before the romanization.
fields.title: Kana cards: say it before you read it
